fantasy.name: Realms of Myth & Magic
fantasy.description: A vibrant world of abundant magic, diverse races, epic dungeons, and an ancient threat.
fantasy.tone_guidelines: Write epic, mythic prose focused on classic high fantasy heroism, political intrigue, and grand adventure.

sci_fi.name: Beyond the Outer Rim
sci_fi.description: An expansive galactic expanse of uncharted star systems, ancient alien ruins, interstellar trading hubs, and rogue spacefarers.
sci_fi.tone_guidelines: Write clinical, awe-inspiring prose focused on technological wonder, interstellar politics, and exploration.

cyberpunk.name: Neon Chrome & Mirrors
cyberpunk.description: A neon-soaked dystopian megacity ruled by ruthless megacorporations, cybernetic black markets, and rogue netrunners.
cyberpunk.tone_guidelines: Write gritty, cynical prose focused on neon-drenched urban decay, corporate oppression, and high-tech rebellion.

steampunk.name: Brass, Steam & Aether
steampunk.description: A soot-choked Victorian metropolis of brass gears, steam-powered airships, clockwork automata, and alchemical mysteries.
steampunk.tone_guidelines: Write ornate, Victorian-styled prose focusing on industrial expansion, clockwork invention, and high society intrigue.

dark_fantasy.name: Cursed Blood & Ashen Crowns
dark_fantasy.description: A cursed land where hope is thin, blood has currency, and every bargain exacts a price.
dark_fantasy.tone_guidelines: Write oppressive, gothic prose where magic is corrupting, mercy is scarce, and the stakes are consistently lethal.

starting_hooks.hook: at 05:30 PM within a bleak, fortified enclave where weary sentinels drink watered ale and murmur grim warnings about the encroaching dark
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Tense military haven, scarred veterans, grim bounty ledger, and cautious social choices.
starting_hooks.focal_point: Huddled near the cracked stone hearth drinking watered ale with scarred sentinels before the twilight gates close

initial_physical_state.posture_qualifier: on a rough wooden bench by the hearth

starting_prop.name: Tarnished Silver Sigil
starting_prop.effect: A blessed silver amulet that burns cold against the skin when undead or cursed blood draw near

starting_hooks.visual_cues: grim twilight seeping through narrow arrow-slits, guttering iron hearth fire, scarred armored sentinels, bleak gothic stone masonry

starting_hooks.hook: at 11:00 AM in the cobblestone square of a plague-shadowed cathedral town where beaked physicians burn sulfur incense and flagellants chant beneath iron gallows
starting_hooks.directive: Open Hub Exploration: Gothic plague-town atmosphere, sulfur-choked air, desperate townsfolk, ominous bounty posts, and cautious exploration choices.
starting_hooks.focal_point: Standing on the bloodstained chapel steps watching silent plague doctors in beaked masks distribute tallow rations

starting_prop.name: Aromatic Censer of Dried Thyme
starting_prop.effect: A small brass burner emitting pungent herbal smoke to mask charnel stench and repel airborne miasma

starting_hooks.visual_cues: pale sickly midday sun veiled by ash clouds, gallows on cobblestones, black-robed plague doctors, stone chapel gargoyles

starting_hooks.hook: at 10:00 PM in the muddy aftermath of a brutal ambush surrounded by burning barricades as shadows stalk the treeline
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Visceral blood-soaked crisis, enemy closing in, wounded allies, and desperate survival choices.
starting_hooks.focal_point: Crawling through bloodstained mud behind burning wooden barricades as horned shadows stalk the tree line

starting_prop.name: Notched Black Iron Dagger
starting_prop.effect: A wicked trench blade forged from meteorite iron that leaves necrotic black marks on monstrous flesh

starting_hooks.visual_cues: midnight darkness illuminated by burning wooden stakes, thick black mud, heavy fog, silhouetted monstrous shadows in woods

starting_hooks.hook: at 03:00 AM trapped in the belfry of a half-collapsed cathedral as a blood-red moon rises and leathery-winged gargoyle beasts smash through the gothic stained glass
starting_hooks.suggested_location: {session_ancient_forest} ➔ Ruined Cathedral Belfry ➔ Shattered Rose Window
starting_hooks.directive: In Media Res: Desperate high-altitude gothic siege, howling nocturnal predators, falling stained glass shards, and violent tactical choices.
starting_hooks.focal_point: Bracing against the cracked bronze cathedral bell as leathery wings buffet the narrow belfry arches

starting_prop.name: Vial of Consecrated Blood
starting_prop.effect: A stoppered glass vial of blessed martyr blood capable of burning occult abominations like boiling acid

starting_hooks.visual_cues: blood-red moon hanging in stormy sky, cracked colossal bronze bell, lunging gothic gargoyle beast, stone debris falling

starting_hooks.hook: at 07:00 PM before the yawning maw of a desecrated crypt as cold fog spills across mossy gravestones and crows scatter
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Dread expedition threshold, occult ward examination, lighting torches, and steeling resolve.
starting_hooks.focal_point: Standing before the yawning maw of the mossy crypt as freezing subterranean mist spills across gravestones

starting_prop.name: Cold Iron Crowbar
starting_prop.effect: An iron prybar inscribed with wards that can pry heavy crypt seals without triggering occult curses

starting_hooks.visual_cues: dusk cold blue fog, cracked tilted gravestones, crows scattering from dead trees, yawning dark stone staircase into crypt

starting_hooks.hook: at 09:00 PM on the rotting wooden boardwalk above a stagnant black bog before a circle of bleached ribcage bones marking a witch-coven threshold
starting_hooks.directive: Delve Threshold: Cursed mire exploration, testing unstable boardwalks, deciphering witch marks, and entering the sunken hollow.
starting_hooks.focal_point: Kneeling at the threshold of a half-submerged wooden hut built from twisted willow roots in stagnant black water

initial_physical_state.posture_qualifier: on the damp mossy bog planks

starting_prop.name: Bone Witch-Talisman
starting_prop.effect: A fetish carved from raven bone that pulses when traversing invisible curse boundaries or illusion wards

starting_hooks.visual_cues: moonlit stagnant swamp water, gnarled willow roots, eerie green will-o'-the-wisps, skulls mounted on wooden poles

isekai_fantasy.name: Summoned to Another World
isekai_fantasy.description: A modern-world individual ripped from their ordinary life and abruptly thrust into a trope-filled fantasy realm full of magic, and monsters.
isekai_fantasy.tone_guidelines: Write energetic, lighthearted prose blending modern sensibilities with high-fantasy tropes and power progression.

high_school_drama.name: Youth, Bells & Rooftop Breezes
high_school_drama.description: A modern high school landscape where social status, academic pressure, and teenage romance collide.
high_school_drama.tone_guidelines: Write engaging slice-of-life, coming-of-age prose that captures the emotional intensity of youth. Balance whimsical, comedic high school banter with genuinely serious moments of social drama, heartbreak, and personal growth. Lean heavily into classic high school tropes and archetype dynamics.

slice_of_life.name: Downtown Lights & Lattes
slice_of_life.description: A vibrant contemporary city district of cozy third-wave cafés, bustling shopping arcades, neon nightlife alleys, and tight-knit neighborhood characters.
slice_of_life.tone_guidelines: Write grounded, character-driven prose balancing warm everyday routines, neighborhood gossip, and personal relationships with street-level urban drama and late-night excitement.

nuclear_post_apocalypse.name: Ashes of the Fallout
nuclear_post_apocalypse.description: A bleak, ash-choked wasteland set a few decades after atomic fire, where radiation, raiders, and mutated horrors stalk the ruins.
nuclear_post_apocalypse.tone_guidelines: Write bleak, gritty, and unforgiving prose where survival of the fittest governs the ruins, occasionally balanced by dark humor.
